evals.name: nightly-dream-workflow
evals.prompt: Outline the exact command sequence and decision rules to run a nightly Hindsight dreaming pass on this repository's memory bank so stale path claims get updated against HEAD, zero-finding review noise and duplicate facts get compacted, completed initiative pages get retired safely, and stale pages refresh without polluting the bank with the dream session's own transcript. Plan only; do not run commands or inspect a live checkout.
evals.expected_output: Uses repo-hindsight-dream status and candidates (passing --session-id when LCARS_SESSION_ID is set), verifies candidate path/rule claims against current HEAD before calling invalidate-memory or retain-doc --kind correction, compacts ephemeral 0-finding review facts, duplicate gitlog:checkout seeds, and near-duplicates while preserving rejected-alternative rationale, checks non-core initiative pages before retiring completed ones with retire-page (never deleting the 5 core taxonomy pages), optionally records 1-3 deterministic dream:evolution:<slug> notes, and finishes with reconcile --refresh-stale (cleaning self-session transcript, recovering failed consolidations, and bounding full refreshes).
assertions: Uses repo-hindsight-dream status and candidates first and passes --session-id (such as $LCARS_SESSION_ID) so the dreaming run excludes and cleans up its own session transcript
Verifies candidate memory claims against current repository HEAD before soft-retiring contradicted raw world/experience facts with invalidate-memory (and notes observations are not patched directly)
Distinguishes ephemeral zero-finding review chatter or duplicate facts (to compact/invalidate) from durable rejected-alternative or why-rationale memories (to preserve)
Checks non-core initiative pages before calling retire-page while keeping all five core taxonomy pages intact, and finishes with repo-hindsight-dream reconcile

evals.name: curate-observation-vs-source-fact
evals.prompt: During a Hindsight memory cleanup pass, I found an observation (obs-123, fact_type: observation) that still claims scripts deploy via `secrets-get`, which was replaced by `secrets get` in commit abc1234. I also see a negative memory saying we tried ONNX Runtime for the CPU reranker and rejected it because batch-8 latency stayed 4.4s. How should I handle both items using the dreaming workflow? Answer as a concrete plan without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Explains that observations are derived and must not be invalidated or edited directly; instead inspect obs-123's source_memory_ids (or list raw world/experience memories mentioning secrets-get), verify against HEAD, invalidate or update those raw source memories with a reason citing commit abc1234, upsert a deterministic dream:correction:<slug> note if the `secrets get` rule is missing, and run reconcile so derived observations regenerate. Preserves the ONNX Runtime negative finding because rejected-alternative benchmarks remain valid rationale even when ONNX is absent from current code.
assertions: States that observation units are derived and should not be patched or invalidated directly, and instead traces source_memory_ids to curate the underlying world/experience facts
Uses invalidate-memory (with a reason citing commit abc1234) and/or deterministic retain-doc --kind correction (dream:correction:<slug>) rather than deleting the whole bank or observations table
Preserves the ONNX Runtime rejected-alternative memory rather than invalidating it merely because ONNX is not used in current code
